finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, the comparable normal price starts at $9 per month for the entry paid tier.

quote.text: Unmixr turns slides and scripts into narrated training videos, with AI voices in 100+ languages, subtitles, transcripts, dubbing and SCORM output, from $9 a month.

finePrint.summary: All usage spends from one credit wallet at fixed rates, so a lifetime buyer should compare allowances in characters and minutes.

quote.text: The rates are fixed and simple: 1 credit = 1 voiceover character, 240 credits = 1 transcription minute, and 1,920 credits = 1 dubbing minute.

finePrint.summary: Even paid plans cap video length, slides and daily videos, so lifetime access is still metered.

quote.text: Up to 15 min per video · 80 slides · 2 videos a day

finePrint.summary: Lifetime plans are only sold from time to time through partner marketplaces like AppSumo, not as a standard direct plan.

quote.text: The Services are offered through subscription plans, credit packs, and, from time to time, lifetime plans sold through partner marketplaces such as AppSumo.

finePrint.summary: AppSumo lifetime plans stay grandfathered with their original allowances and are not converted to new monthly credit wallets.

quote.text: Their AppSumo plan stays grandfathered and receives the separate allowances promised in the AppSumo offer; it is not converted into the new monthly convertible-credit wallet unless they later choose to subscribe to a new Unmixr plan.

finePrint.summary: Existing AppSumo lifetime plans continue unchanged, which is reassuring for current lifetime holders.

quote.text: Already subscribed? Your current plan, including AppSumo/LTD plans, continues unchanged with its existing allowances.

finePrint.summary: There is no fixed-day refund window; buyers must contact support within a reasonable period with details.

quote.text: To request a refund, contact us at support@unmixr.com within a reasonable period after the issue arises, including the transaction details, a description of the issue, and any supporting documentation.

finePrint.summary: Refunds are case-by-case and not automatic, so a lifetime buyer cannot expect an instant refund.

quote.text: Refunds are not automatic; each request is reviewed against this policy.

finePrint.summary: Marketplace lifetime purchases like AppSumo are refunded by that marketplace, not directly by Unmixr.

quote.text: Purchases made through a partner marketplace (such as AppSumo) are refunded through that marketplace under its own refund policy, not by us directly.

finePrint.summary: Unmixr can change products and pricing at any time, with price changes applying at the next renewal.

quote.text: We reserve the right to change products and pricing at any time; price changes to an existing subscription will be notified to you in advance and take effect at your next renewal.

finePrint.summary: Unmixr can modify the terms at any time, and continued use counts as acceptance.

quote.text: We reserve the right to modify this Agreement at any time.

finePrint.summary: Voices, languages or features may change or disappear over time due to third-party providers.

quote.text: The Services depend in part on third-party AI providers, and specific voices, languages, or features may change or become unavailable over time.

finePrint.summary: Unmixr can suspend, disable or delete an account for violation or harmful conduct or content.

quote.text: We may suspend, disable, or delete your account (or any part of it) if we determine that you have violated this Agreement or that your conduct or content is harmful to us, other users, or third parties.

finePrint.summary: Violating prohibited uses can lead to suspension or termination of service.

quote.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your use of the Services for violating any of the prohibited uses outlined above.

finePrint.summary: Unmixr targets 99% monthly availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted service.

quote.text: We aim to keep the Services available at all times and target 99% availability per month, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted service.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 300k words per month for writing features
trials.claimQuote: 300k words per month for the writing features
trials.reasoning: Reviews say promised AI features were downgraded to low-token responses and monthly credits do not renew as expected, materially limiting the promised 300k words per month.

exhibits.quote: They've taken our money without delivering on initial commitments, by downgrading my promised others Chat or AI features, and restricting my access to ALL "premium AI models" (and force low tokens responses).
exhibits.argument: Quote shows AI features were downgraded to low-token responses, undermining a 300k words per month writing promise.

exhibits.quote: "monthly credits" don't renew as expected but only upon full usage, forcing you to utilize unwanted features.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows monthly credits do not renew normally, undermining the promised monthly word allowance.

exhibits.argument: Quote shows image generation deducts extra credits, undermining that 10 images are included.
